tasks.title: Create durable-dispatch.ts
tasks.description:
NEW src/domain/durable-dispatch.ts. Define pure dispatch work keys and acceptance receipts plus lease fencing and crash rules. Tests: src/domain/durable-dispatch.test.ts

REVIEW FAIL (code): Dispatch recovery can complete the wrong operation — FR-001.
  WHERE: src/domain/durable-dispatch.ts:124-127,167-185,239-255
  EXPECTED: Distinct accepted work keys cannot complete from the same branch-level pull request without evidence linking it to the operation.
  ACTUAL: Task sets [T001] and [T002] both return create_new with branch feat/049-example-phase-01. Recovery returns complete_from_pr for the second operation when given the first operation's pull request.
  FIX: Preserve the work key scope in branch and recovery identity, or serialize shared branch use and require an operation-specific link before completing from a pull request. Cover distinct task sets and stale recovery in the phase gate.

REVIEW/GATE DIVERGENCE (T001, gate: gates/phase-01.sh, REVIEW FAIL block appended, status left unchanged):
The review agent raised a finding on this task and its gate still passes, so the gate does not cover what review found. Add a test that fails on it, then fix, before completing.

DIAGNOSIS (iteration 2):
FIX: src/domain/durable-dispatch.ts — In `evaluateDispatchAcceptance`, append `--dispatch-<sha256>` to the phase branch. Hash `[projectId, workKey, newOperationId]` as JSON with `import { createHash } from "node:crypto"`. Update `parseHarvestBranch` in `src/domain/durable-harvest.ts` to strip that suffix before resolving the feature and phase. Require matching `operationId: string | null` on each open or merged pull request in `WorkerRecoveryEvidence` before returning `complete_from_pr`. Pass `operationId` and `workKey` through `WorkerExecutionPort.inspectRecoveredWork` in `src/ports/operations-port.ts`. Verify the repository and operation-specific head ref or a persisted pull request link before setting the evidence ID.
FIX: specs/049-durable-dispatch-harvest/gates/phase-01.sh — Use the existing `src/domain/durable-dispatch.test.ts` gate entry to prove `[T001]` and `[T002]` get distinct branches. Assert that stale recovery rejects the first operation’s open and merged pull requests for the second operation. Retain a positive case for matching evidence.
FIX: src/domain/durable-harvest.ts — In `verifyHarvestTarget`, reject `prNumber` unless `Number.isSafeInteger(prNumber) && prNumber > 0`. For non-null `prUrl`, parse it with `URL` and require the HTTPS GitHub origin and `/<owner>/<repo>/pull/<number>` path for the enrolled repository and exact pull request number. Compare repository slugs case-insensitively. Return `INVALID_PR_NUMBER` or `PR_URL_MISMATCH` before calling `computeHarvestWorkKey`.
FIX: src/domain/durable-harvest.ts — Add `headRepoSlug: string | null` to `HarvestCandidateInput` and the input to `evaluateBranchCleanupSafety`. Add the same field to `HarvestPullRequestFact` and `DurableHarvestOperation` in `src/ports/operations-port.ts`. Populate it from GitHub’s head repository and persist it through intake and replay. Keep unknown values `null`. Return `block_cleanup` with `HEAD_REPO_MISMATCH` unless the head repository matches enrollment. Keep the expected SHA check before returning `delete_at_tip`.
FIX: specs/049-durable-dispatch-harvest/gates/phase-01.sh — Use the existing `src/domain/durable-harvest.test.ts` gate entry to reject zero and fractional pull request numbers. Independently test malformed URLs, a different repository and a different pull request number. With matching branch names and tips, assert that fork and unknown heads block deletion and that an enrolled-repository head permits it.
FIX: src/ports/operations-port.ts — Add `listRecoverableHarvests(input: { nowIso: string; projectId?: string }): DurableHarvestOperation[]` and `listRecoverableOutboxItems(input: { nowIso: string; projectId: string }): OutboxItem[]` to `OperationsStorePort`. Return unstarted `accepted` harvests even without stage receipts and resumable harvests without a live lease. Return project-scoped `pending`, `uncertain` and abandoned `sending` items in creation order. Keep claims atomic and route recovered `sending` and `uncertain` items to `reconcile`.
FIX: specs/049-durable-dispatch-harvest/gates/phase-01.sh — Add `src/ports/operations-port.test.ts` to the Vitest command. Use an injected `OperationsStorePort` fixture rebuilt from persisted rows alone. Discover and claim an unstarted harvest and a pending send without retaining their intake IDs. Assert `reconcile` for abandoned `sending` and `uncertain` items. Exclude live leases, terminal rows and outbox rows from other projects. Add both query names to the existing interface check in `src/architecture.test.ts`.

REVIEW FAIL (code): Lease fence can accept a claim from another operation — FR-003.
  WHERE: src/domain/durable-dispatch.ts:221-245
  EXPECTED: Require current.operationId and return LEASE_FENCED when it differs from candidate.operationId, even if owner and epoch match.
  ACTUAL: current.operationId?: string makes the comparison conditional. A lease projection from operation B with owner worker-a and epoch 1 returned { ok: true } for operation A's fence when the projection omitted its ID.
  FIX: Require operation identity on the current lease and compare it unconditionally. Add a gate case with two operations sharing the same owner and epoch.

REVIEW/GATE DIVERGENCE (T001, gate: gates/phase-01.sh, REVIEW FAIL block appended, status left unchanged):
The review agent raised a finding on this task and its gate still passes, so the gate does not cover what review found. Add a test that fails on it, then fix, before completing.

REVIEW FAIL (code): Stale dispatch retries while pull request ownership is unresolved — FR-001.
  WHERE: src/domain/durable-dispatch.ts:247-285; src/domain/durable-dispatch.test.ts:282-308
  EXPECTED: Requeue a stopped worker only after GitHub evidence rules out an open or merged pull request for the operation. Hold recovery when a candidate pull request has unresolved ownership.
  ACTUAL: With workerState: "stopped", attemptCount: 1 and openPullRequest.operationId: null, the policy returns "requeue_attempt". The test expects the same retry for both a known foreign operation and unresolved ownership.
  FIX: Distinguish confirmed absence or a known foreign pull request from unresolved identity or an unavailable lookup. Keep the operation pending on unresolved evidence. Gate stopped-worker recovery for both open and merged candidates with unknown ownership.

REVIEW/GATE DIVERGENCE (T001, gate: gates/phase-01.sh, REVIEW FAIL block appended, status left unchanged):
The review agent raised a finding on this task and its gate still passes, so the gate does not cover what review found. Add a test that fails on it, then fix, before completing.

DIAGNOSIS (iteration 2):
FIX: src/domain/durable-dispatch.ts — Keep `import { createHash } from "node:crypto"` and the `--dispatch-<sha256>` branch suffix derived from `JSON.stringify([projectId, workKey, newOperationId])`. Keep suffix parsing in `src/domain/durable-harvest.ts`. In `src/ports/operations-port.ts`, require `inspectRecoveredWork` to verify the repository and either the operation-specific head ref or a persisted pull request link before assigning `operationId`. Keep the gated cases in `src/domain/durable-dispatch.test.ts` for distinct task branches, foreign open and merged pull requests, and matching evidence.
FIX: src/domain/durable-dispatch.ts — Keep `current.operationId: string` required in `validateLeaseFence`. Return `LEASE_FENCED` whenever it differs from `candidate.operationId`. Keep the gated case in `src/domain/durable-dispatch.test.ts` where two operations share the same owner and epoch.
FIX: src/domain/durable-dispatch.ts — Add required `pullRequestLookup: "complete" | "unavailable"` to `WorkerRecoveryEvidence`. After checking for a verified match, return `await_pr_evidence` when the lookup is unavailable or either candidate has `operationId: null`. Run retry and exhaustion logic only after a complete lookup rules out a match. In `src/domain/durable-dispatch.test.ts`, split the foreign and unknown ownership cases. Assert that a stopped worker waits for unresolved open or merged evidence and unavailable lookups, including at the retry limit. Keep retry cases for confirmed absence and known foreign evidence.
FIX: src/domain/durable-harvest.ts — Keep `verifyHarvestTarget` rejecting nonpositive or unsafe integers with `INVALID_PR_NUMBER`. Require any supplied URL to use `https://github.com` and match the enrolled repository and exact `/pull/<number>` path. Return `PR_URL_MISMATCH` before deriving the work key. Keep the independent number, malformed URL, wrong repository and wrong pull request cases in `src/domain/durable-harvest.test.ts`.
FIX: src/domain/durable-harvest.ts — Keep `headRepoSlug: string | null` separate from the base repository in `HarvestCandidateInput`, `HarvestPullRequestFact` and `DurableHarvestOperation`. Populate it from GitHub’s head repository and preserve it through intake and replay. Treat missing values as `null`. In `evaluateBranchCleanupSafety`, require a matching head repository and expected tip before `delete_at_tip`. Keep the gated same-branch and same-tip cases for enrolled, fork and unknown heads.
FIX: src/domain/durable-harvest.ts — Keep `phaseIds: readonly string[]` required by `deriveHarvestTerminalStatus`. Pass the planned phase IDs on intake and replay. Require a finished receipt for every planned phase and stage before returning a terminal success status. Keep the gated two-phase case in `src/domain/durable-harvest.test.ts` that omits every receipt for the second phase and expects `running`.
FIX: src/domain/durable-harvest.ts — In `verifyHarvestTarget`, keep `MISSING_MERGE_SHA` for blank or null values. Reject other merged candidates with `INVALID_MERGE_SHA` unless the trimmed value matches ` /^(?:[0-9a-f]{40}|[0-9a-f]{64})$/i` before work-key derivation. At checkout, verify that the ID identifies a commit and matches the repository’s object format. In `src/domain/durable-harvest.test.ts`, accept full SHA-1 and SHA-256 IDs and reject `HEAD`, branch names, abbreviated IDs and nonhex strings.
FIX: src/ports/operations-port.ts — Keep `OperationsStorePort.listRecoverableHarvests({ nowIso, projectId? })` and `listRecoverableOutboxItems({ nowIso, projectId })` in the interface and architecture check. Return eligible rows in creation order and recheck eligibility on atomic claim. Keep the phase-gated `src/ports/operations-port.test.ts` restart fixture covering harvests without receipts, pending sends, reconciliation of abandoned `sending` and `uncertain` items, and exclusion of live claims, terminal rows and outbox rows from other projects.
FIX: src/ports/operations-port.ts — Keep `taskIds: readonly string[]` required by `WorkerExecutionPort.launchPhaseShip`. Pass the persisted `DurableDispatchOperation.taskIds` on every launch and use `[]` for phase-wide work. Keep the phase-gated injected-worker test in `src/ports/operations-port.test.ts` for two distinct task scopes in the same phase after restart.
FIX: src/ports/operations-port.ts — Keep `destination: OutboxDestination | null` on `claimOutboxItem`. Atomically bind the resolved workspace, channel and thread with the existing `clientMetadataKey` before sending. Reconcile at the stored destination and preserve it through fenced completion. Keep the phase-gated restart case in `src/ports/operations-port.test.ts` where the feature thread changes after sending and before the delivery receipt commits.
FIX: src/ports/operations-port.ts — Add `OperationsStorePort.heartbeatHarvestLease(input: { fence: LeaseFence; nowIso: string; leaseExpiresAt: string }): FencedWrite`. Atomically validate the operation ID, owner, epoch and current expiry before extending the lease. Keep the epoch unchanged on renewal. Add the method to `src/architecture.test.ts` and the phase-gated fixture in `src/ports/operations-port.test.ts`. Test renewal before expiry, `LEASE_EXPIRED` at expiry and `LEASE_FENCED` for the old epoch after takeover.

  ACTUAL: verifyHarvestTarget returns ok: true with prNumber: 0 and prUrl: https://github.com/acme/other/pull/42 for enrolled repository acme/repo.
  FIX: Reject invalid numbers and conflicting supplied pull request identities. Add both cases to the phase gate.
